item.title: The Space Marine 2 Steam Workshop is open!
item.description:
​Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce that the official Space Marine 2 Steam Workshop is now open! 

👉 Learn more right here

When playing with mods, you’ll be disconnected from the public matchmaking and placed in a private lobby. You can invite other players to your session using either an invite or a code. In a modded session, a watermark will be displayed at the top right corner of your screen.

Additionally, your game progression will be separated from the official game.

🖱️ Want to create a mod?

Certain conditions and restrictions apply, so make sure to read our modder's guidelines and the legal notice

When you have, you’ll find a complete guide explaining how to start modding!

item.title: The Confrontation Update is available now!
item.description:
Hello, Space Marines!

The Confrontation Update is now live for Space Marine 2, bringing Year 2 to an epic conclusion!

Patch 14.0 introduces two new PvP maps, a new Thousand Sons Terminus enemy, new Heroic weapons and armour pieces, plus the final Season Pass 2 cosmetic DLCs.

Watch the Confrontation Update Trailer below:

A BIG UPDATE FOR PvP ⚔️

Patch 14.0 expands Eternal War with two new PvP Arenas:

  • Sanctum on Avarax

  • Facility on Demerium

[carousel][/carousel]

The update also adds new weekly PvP rewards and Ordeals. Play Eternal War matches, complete Datavault challenges, and earn exclusive accolades and cosmetics.

PvE also gets deadlier with the arrival of a new Terminus enemy: the Thousand Sons Scarab Occult Terminator Sorcerer. Encounter this formidable foe in every Chaos Operation and throughout Siege mode.

NEW COSMETIC DLCs FOR SALAMANDERS AND RAPTORS
The Salamanders Champion Pack 2 🦎

It includes a new Heavy Champion skin and an exclusive Multi-Melta skin.

[carousel][/carousel]

The Raptors Cosmetic Pack 🐦‍⬛

It features five unique armour pieces inspired by the Chapter's iconic combat doctrine.

[carousel][/carousel]

Get it now!

Purge the xenos and heretics with the Space Marine 2 Confrontation Update, and don't forget to join the Space Marine 2 community.

THE EMPEROR PROTECTS

item.title: Mod Manager & New Launch Options
item.description:
Hey folks,

For those of you jumping into some Total War: WARHAMMER II today, you may notice a small update as we’ve just expanded our Mod Manager Early Access to include Warhammer II.

(Screenshot taken from original WH3 version)

From today, when you launch WH2 on Steam, you’ll now be given the option to play the game via the original launcher, via the Early Access Mod Manager, or by booting straight into the game. Our goal is to make playing Warhammer II with mods an easier, more streamlined process, so you can spend less time organising your mods and more time in the game!

You can read more on how the Mod Manager works in our original blog post from November 2025, as well as any improvements since then over in the Mod Manager forums. The forums are also the ideal palce to share your thoughts on the Mod Manager itself, both positive and negative, to help us make further improvements in the future.

Thanks, and enjoy!

— Steve, and the Total War Mod Manager Team

item.title: Patch Notes 14.0
item.description:
​Patch Notes 14.0

The 14.0 patch is now live on every platform. Read the complete patch notes down below.

Features that have changed since the PTS’ Patch Notes are flagged with this icon: 🟡

NEW FEATURES

New PvP map: Sanctum

Sanctum is a medium-sized PvP map built for dynamic and exciting battles. The map features open combat areas, fast routes to key engagement zones and a central area designed as the main hotspot for intense firefights.

New PvP map: Facility

Facility is one of the most compact PvP maps designed for fast-paced and intense combat. The map maximises opportunities for flanking attacks, rotations and outmaneuvering the enemy.

​

[carousel][/carousel]
New Enemy: Scarab Occult Terminator Sorcerer

Meet the new Terminus enemy: the Scarab Occult Terminator Sorcerer, part of the mighty Thousand Sons. He wields powerful magic for both close and long-range attacks, and is also capable of creating potent illusions.

New Feature: New Medals and Scores for PvP

Medals and Achievements: enhanced visual effects that highlight a player’s accomplishments during a match. They affect match statistics and the experience points a player earns.

New Feature: Trials of Resolve #2

Four new challenging Ordeals to get new items have been added, designed for experienced players.

New Feature: Wargear 2.01

This is a small intermediate update to the wargear system. 

We are adding a 3rd Wargear slot to some classes so tabards and capes could be equipped at the same time. 

This is why some tabards were removed from some chest pieces in this patch in preparation to be moved to a separate slot. 

With Patch 15 you will be able to equip everything together.

In addition to that, with the next update robes and tabards are coming to Vanguard and Heavy.

Capes for Bulwark are also in the works, however it will take a bit more time (not in Patch 15), since robes need to be removed from chest pieces first.

Oh and "Something we should have done a long time ago" customization feature also coming in Patch 15 :)

Robes for the Assault and Tactical classes have been added, along with tabards for the Assault class which can be earned by completing new Ordeals.

New Feature: Weekly Rewards for Participation in PvP

Earn Accolades for participating in PvP on weekly basis

New Feature: PvP Team Reshuffle

At the end of a PvP match players will be randomly assigned to teams based on match results (experimental feature, will be turned on and off on backend)

New Heroic Items

  • Added 6 Heroic Weapons (Thunder Hammer, Power Fist, Bolt Carbine, Melta Rifle, Power Sword, Stalker Bolt Rifle) to unlock with Accolades.

  • Added 4 Heroic Armour (Deathwatch Hand, Deathwatch Chest, Ultramarine Chapter Champion Pauldron) parts to unlock with Accolades.

New Season Pass Content

  • Salamanders Champion with its Signature Multi-Melta Weapon Skin.

  • Raptors Cosmetic Pack.

[carousel][/carousel]

​

GAMEPLAY & BALANCING TWEAKS

Firearms in PvE

Heroic Bolt Pistol 

  • Damage increased by 15%.

Secondary Bolt Carbine 

  • Maximum ammo increased by 2 magazines for all versions. (🟡Added 2 magazines instead of 1.)

Pyrecannon

  • Increased range by 15% in both stances.

Burn damage

  • Auspex Scan no longer affects Burn damage.

Melee in PvE

Omnissian Axe

  • “Explosive Strike” perk of Omnissian Axe now causes an energy explosion at the point of impact on the enemy.

  • Ultima Ratio (Heroic Omnissian Axe): The time to reach the maximum additional damage was reduced by 35%.

New Heroic Weapons

🟡 Following your feedback on the PTS, the 6 new Heroic weapons received buffs:

🟡 Salamanders Power Sword

We understand that a lot of you wanted it to be a burning blade, but only Guilliman gets to wield one.

  • Fixed perk activation, now it should work according to description and should affect only light attacks.

  • Increased max stacks from 5 to 6.

  • Increased number of stacks you gain per perfect parry from 1 to 3.

🟡 Combi-Flamer Bolt Carbine

  • Increased damage by 20% for bolter barrel.

  • Increased burn status effect accumulation speed for flamer barrel.

  • Fixed ammo refill for flamer barrel.

🟡 Deathwatch Stalker Bolt Rifle

  • Decreased number of body shots to activate perk effect from 5 to 4.

  • Perk now activates on any body shots, not on body shots on a single target.

  • Increased headshot damage multiplier to match Relic versions.

  • Increased perk damage bonus to 30% versus minoris, majoris and extremis enemies and to 10% versus terminus enemies.

🟡 Salamanders Melta Rifle

  • Increased damage fall-off range.

  • Increased damage by 10%.

🟡 Deathwatch Power Fist

  • Improved animation responsiveness for entering melta blast stance.

  • Fixed tracking for the melta blast move.

  • Greatly increased direct damage for melta blast move.

  • Melta blast burn effect AoE is slightly wider.

  • Added directional input to melta blast move.

🟡 Lord Executioner's Axe

  • Now properly restores contested health with new attacks

PvE Perks

This patch is very light on perk changes, but big promise rework is coming for Tactical class with the next update.

Techmarine

  • Perk "Methodical Destruction" now works with Prometium Can.

PvP Balance Tweaks

Overall, we want to try to make Eternal War more accessible for everybody. So people can pick it up and enjoy it. Rest assured, this isn't the last Eternal War update. 

We are planning to add a new very very big feature to it so it will be more enjoyable for all players.

Removed progression in PvP

  • All weapons and equipment are available from Level 1.

Shock Grenade

  • Blindness Radius reduced from 9 to 4 meters 

  • Blindness Duration reduced from 1.5 to 1.1 seconds for

Krak Grenade 

  • Now always destroys the Heavy’s Iron Halo

Assault

  • Ground Pound min and max damage radius have been reduced:

Chainsword — inner radius is reduced from 2 to 1.5; outer radius is reduced from 4 to 3.

Thunder Hammer — inner radius is reduced from 2.5 to 2; outer radius is reduced from 5 to 3.5.

Power Fist — inner radius is reduced from 2 to 1.5; outer radius is reduced from 4 to 3.

Power Sword — inner radius is reduced from 2.5 to 2; outer radius is reduced from 5 to 3.5.

Power Axe — inner radius is reduced from 2 to 1.5; outer radius is reduced from 4 to 3.

🟡Partically reverted outer damage radius for some weapons compared to PTS:

Chainsword — outer radius changed from 2.5 to 3.

Power Fist — outer radius changed from 2.5 to 3.

Power Axe — outer radius changed from 2.5 to 3.

  • Ability charge cooldown is increased from 12 to 16 seconds

  • 🟡Fully reverted change from PTS: Ground Pound charge aim max angle is reduced from 50 to 38 degrees 

Vanguard

  • Ability charge cooldown is reduced from 30 to 18 seconds

  • Ability damage is increased from 10 to 25

  • Ability charges are increased from 2 to 3.

Bulwark

  • The damage cap required to knock Bulwark out of shield stance has been reduced from 300 to 200.

ORDEALS

🟡Reduced the number of kills required for new Eternal War ordeals to 50/200/500 compared to the PBE requirements

SIEGE MODE

Tech Priest:

  • Effectiveness has been greatly reduced: Base max income now starts at 720 for the team and gradually decreases with each wave to 300 at wave 30+ like all other sources of income.

Increased wave completion and side objective resource rewards by 20%.

Increased Enemy Damage Resistance Cap on high waves:

  • From 60% to 72% for regular enemies

  • From 80% to 88% for Terminus enemies

Scarab Occult Terminator Sorcerer added as miniboss.

Siege Mode Accolade rewards are now given based on reaching wave 15, not surviving 15 waves.

LEVELS

Lots of minor fixes with level geometry.

CUSTOMISATION

Added robes for Assault and Tactical classes to be unlocked with new Ordeals.

Added tabards for Assault class to be unlocked with new Ordeals.

Added Mark X Pristine Aquilla to Refinement and Redemption shop.

Added free Raptors knee decal.

Black Templar Champion backpack split into 2 parts. Skeleton part is now a part of a wargear slot and can be used on Heavy class.

Lots of minor customisation fixes for both Loyalists and Chaos.

ENEMIES

Lots of minor fixes with animations.

🟡Scarab Occult Terminator Sorcerer:

  • Third flurry attack is now ripostable in both combo variations

  • Reduced beam attack damage by 33%

  • Increased beam attack cooldown by 15%

  • Perfect Dodging Beam attack now applies Gunstrike Mark

  • Beam attack illusions follow up now has 8 sec cooldown

  • Beam attack illusions follow up is slightly easier to avoid

  • Split into three illusions attack is no longer interruptable

  • Reduced hp of illusions by ~15%

  • Illusions focus slightly less on range attacks

  • Radial beam attack cooldown increased by 25%, follow up attacks will happen with a slightly bigger delay

  • AI Director: Reinforcement waves no longer include Ranged Scarab Occult Terminators

  • AI Director: Reinforcement waves will have smaller chances of having Lesser Sorcerors

  • Various Bug Fixes

GENERAL FIXES

Fixed a bug with Sniper's “Efficient Readiness” perk not reloading the gun if the player used the ability after the “Lingering Concealment” perk effect.

Fixed an issue with Siege Mode accolades rewards not being awarded in some cases.

Fixed a bug with the Bolt Sniper Rifle "Strong Start" perk not working consistently with the Heroic Bolt Sniper Rifle.

Fixed a bug with Vanguard's "Tactical Prowess" perk not working on the Zoanthrope in some rare cases.

Fixed a bug with "Split up" and "Squad Unity" battlefield conditions working with bots and interfering with gameplay.

Fixed a bug with  "Split up" and "Squad Unity" battlefield conditions activating and deactivating at inconsistent distances.

Fixed a bug with Tactical’s "Kraken Penetration Rounds" class perk affecting burn damage when switching to a bolt weapon.

Fixed a bug with Tactical’s "Kraken Penetration Rounds" class perk affecting projectile weapons (grenade launchers) when switching to a bolt weapon as they fly.

Fixed a bug with “Suspicious Behaviour” battlefield condition dealing full damage to allies instead of 50% damage.

Fixed an issue with the headshot damage of the Heavy Bolt Rifle Relic "Ophelian Liberation Beta" not working properly.

Lots of minor fixes for Blessing and Atonement system in Siege.

Lots of minor bug fixes.

Lots of minor localisation bug fixes.

Lots of minor UI and sound fixes.

TECH

Crash fixes and general stability improvements.

Loading time optimisation.

Memory optimisations.

Minor performance improvements.

General connectivity improvements.
